AetherArch is a next-generation file archiver with neural-probabilistic compression.
It uses content-defined chunking, adaptive entropy routing, and context-mixing prediction.
Structured data like text and source code compresses exceptionally well because the
predictor learns the statistical patterns of the input and feeds probabilities to a
range coder, which encodes bytes using fractions of a bit when prediction confidence
is high. This paragraph repeats key phrases to give the predictor material to learn:
neural-probabilistic compression, context-mixing prediction, adaptive entropy routing,
content-defined chunking, range coding, AetherArch, file archiver.
